messages:
samira_pm: Hey folks, dropped a compact landing mock for the Billing experience: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/billing-compact. Main dilemma: where to place the primary invoice action and how obvious the org vs project scope is. Need quick opinions before Friday review.

leo_design: I pushed two variants: (A) prominent org banner with 'Download invoice' and small project rail below, (B) project-first grid with a persistent org badge in the header. My gut: A reduces mistaken assumptions about billing scope.

marcus_frontend: Variant A is cheaper on initial API calls (single agg). If we go with B, we'll need lazy-load for the project list and a server hint for default scope to avoid a flash of wrong content.

anya_billing: From ops: invoices and payment methods are org-scoped. If any UI shows project-first, add a clear marker like "Invoices billed to: ORGANIZATION NAME" and make the invoice CTA explicitly say 'Org invoice'.

leo_design: Good call. I'll change button copy to 'Download org invoice (PDF)'. For project cards I'm adding a subdued 'View billing context' link that routes to org invoice with project preselected in the modal.

marcus_frontend: Implementation note: project card expand should fetch only a lightweight ledger summary (tokens, est. charges, top models). Full route-level CSV should be behind the modal and require a separate export job.

dina_a11y: Accessibility checklist: 1) scope controls are real buttons with aria-pressed. 2) invoice button has descriptive aria-label including date range. 3) any card expand traps focus and is dismissible via Esc. 4) sparklines must expose SR-only tables. Also ensure contrast on the status badges >=4.5:1.

samira_pm: Great. Also adding a micro-toggle in the ledger preview: 'Show tokens as % / absolute'. Support asked for % view in a bunch of tickets. Keep it small, inside the preview header.

leo_design: I'll wire that toggle as a segmented control with aria-live updates for SR users. Also making the ledger preview default to collapsed to keep landing height small.

anya_billing: CSV export needs RBAC gating. Only billing admins should see 'Export ledger (CSV)'. For others show 'Request export' which opens a ticket modal. Also show estimate: "May take ~30-120s and include X rows" after they request.

marcus_frontend: We'll implement export as an async job returning job_id; frontend polls progress and streams a download when ready. Small perf ask: do not render hundreds of route rows in the DOM — paginate server-side.

dina_a11y: Modal accessibility: provide a clear header, associate the export warning with aria-describedby, and ensure the download link is a real <a> so screen readers announce the file type.

samira_pm: Action list: Leo: update copy + segmented token toggle + reduce landing vertical length (due today). Marcus: spec for lazy-load + export job + paginated ledger (PR next week). Anya: confirm RBAC copy and export warning text. Dina: run an a11y smoke test on the updated mock. Ops-bot: reminder for design review Friday 09:00 UTC. :calendar:

ops-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled Friday 09:00 UTC.

leo_design: Updated figma link after changes: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/billing-compact?node-id=55%3A6 — switched to 'Download org invoice (PDF)', added 'View billing context' on cards, and lowered contrast issues.

marcus_frontend: One last question: should the project rail show top 5 projects by spend or most-recently-viewed? Which is more useful?

samira_pm: Let's default to top spend with a small dropdown to switch to 'recent'. Track clicks to see what users prefer.

anya_billing: Minor copy tweak: change 'Est charges' -> 'Estimated charges (pre-tax)'. Legal prefers clarity.

leo_design: Done. Dina, will ping when mocks are ready for your smoke test. Closing thread unless blockers appear.
